source.name: San Antonio Spurs – 'San Antonio Spurs Partner with Digital Asset Security Leader Ledger in New Global Jersey Patch Deal'
source.quote: The San Antonio Spurs today announced a new jersey patch partnership with Ledger, the world leader in digital asset security for consumers and enterprises
source.note: Multi-year deal; the release says the patch debuts at the 2025 NBA draft. The page blocks the script check (403) and serves the quote from its embedded JSON; opened in a browser it reads as above.
